label: Still-Life Light
description: Studio light built for objects and food rather than faces — texture, speculars, steam and glass. Low-key setups carry the 'dark' tag.

items.name: window-rake
items.text: one tall window off to the side, light raking across the subject to carve every texture, a black flag deepening the shadow side into quiet cinematic contrast

items.name: overhead-scrim-glow
items.text: a large scrim directly overhead pooling soft toplight, one low backlight skimming from behind to lift steam and rim the edges

items.name: backlit-glass
items.text: hard backlight burning through the subject, liquids and translucent edges glowing like stained glass, the front held up by a whisper of fill

items.name: twin-strip-speculars
items.text: two vertical strip softboxes flanking from behind, long unbroken highlights drawn down every curved and polished surface

items.name: mirror-bounce-build
items.text: one hard key redirected through mirrors and white cards, every reflection placed deliberately, gradient highlights sweeping across glossy surfaces

items.name: dappled-gobo
items.text: sunlight broken by a leafy gobo, organic shadow patterns wandering across set and surface, a warm outdoor feeling built indoors

items.name: strobe-freeze
items.text: a bare strobe burst at action-freezing duration, liquid and motion arrested crystal-sharp, edges etched clean by twin rim lights

items.name: soft-tent-wrap
items.text: a full diffusion tent, shadowless wraparound light for flawless surface control, reflections reduced to one soft window shape

items.name: gridded-void
items.text: a single gridded spot in a black studio, the subject carved out of darkness, the spill feathering to nothing at the beam edge

items.name: candle-dutch
items.text: candle-warm light from one low source, deep amber shadows swallowing the edges of the set, the geometry of a Dutch still-life painting

items.name: north-window-dark
items.text: cool north-window light falling into a dark room, one side of the subject luminous and the other lost, dust visible in the beam

items.name: low-slash
items.text: one hard low light slashing across the set just above table height, long dramatic shadows thrown behind every object, the background falling to black
